crossRefs.note: Thus were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was…
Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and…
I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the…

translations.web: The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;
translations.bsb: The tree you saw that grew large and strong, whose top reached the sky and was visible to all the earth,
translations.kjv: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;
translations.asv: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;
